t: Professional degreaser ideal for difficult cleaning tasks around the workshop, garden or garage. Fast-acting and effective on a wide range of soils including grease, grime, wax, tar, polish, paint, scuff marks, ink, brake dust, silicone, sealant, bitumen, asphalt, adhesives and wet PU foam. Can be used on most surfaces including metal, glass, plastic and painted or sealed wood. Does not leave an oil film.
